column1: # Differential regex corpus (ADR-003). GENERATED, then committed.
#   verdict = the NORMALISED pattern, or "!" followed by the refusal
#             reason when the pattern is outside the subset.
# Both ports run their own normaliser over every pattern below and must
# reproduce the verdict byte for byte. That is what makes "the two
# normalisers are the same function" a checked claim rather than an
# assertion in a comment: this file was produced by running BOTH and
# diffing, and it fails in whichever port drifts.
# The patterns come from a seeded generator over the atom vocabulary
# (accepted and refused constructs mixed), not from random input at test
# time -- a fuzzer that reseeds in CI is a flaky test, and this
# repository pins determinism as a contract. To extend the corpus,
# regenerate with a new seed, re-run both ports, and commit the diff
# Reasons are included deliberately: a port that refuses the same
# patterns for different stated reasons has still drifted.
